Boundaries.Name: pubsub-direct-activation
Boundaries.Contract: Start the final dispatch owner before subscription construction, admission or activation; complete after rollback and control-gate cleanup.

Boundaries.Name: pubsub-borrowed-activation
Boundaries.Contract: Borrow the caller owner through subscription construction, activation, fan-out and rollback. Detached recovery never borrows a returned activation owner.

Boundaries.Name: pubsub-control
Boundaries.Contract: Activation and reconciliation borrow their logical owner through command construction, transport and reply disposal. Unsubscribe and ordinary replay start an independent internal owner and exclude shutdown cancellation.

Boundaries.Name: pubsub-ordinary-recovery-control
Boundaries.Contract: The control helper owns a failure-only internal replay attempt; no nested final publication and no error for subscription shutdown.
